skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the essence of the theory of change and the role of results-based management in managing development activities.
Students explain the intervention logic in development activities based on results-based management principles.
Students evaluate development indicators according to SMART criteria and propose improvements.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyze Context and Nature of Development Activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students analyze the context and nature of development activities to choose and justify appropriate evaluation methods.
Students organize and manage group discussions to identify stakeholders and present ideas for suitable monitoring and evaluation systems.
Students design logical frameworks for development projects, including problem trees, goal trees, and result frameworks.
Students set up a results-based monitoring system for development interventions.
Students create evaluation report templates that meet specific formats and requirements.
Students demonstrate enthusiasm and engagement when working with communities through practical fieldwork during project design.
Students develop a self-learning attitude, independently researching international materials, and taking responsibility for their own and group products.
